SAP digital payments add-on
/content/sapdx/countries/en_us/registration/request-demo.html

Process and automate credit card and digital payments with SAP S/4HANA

Easily enable credit card and other digital payments in SAP S/4HANA. Connect payment service providers to SAP S/4HANA, and centrally manage and process all digital payment transactions.

Benefits

  • Integrate multiple payment methods and service providers

    Offer support for multiple payment service providers and payment methods, including credit cards, debit cards, digital wallets (e.g., PayPal and Apple Pay), and regional options through a single, standardized processing platform and interface.

  • Save costs with automated SAP S/4HANA payment processing

    Integrated with SAP S/4HANA, the SAP digital payments add-on automates and optimizes payment processing using standard interfaces, allowing you to choose the payment method and service provider that work the best for you.

  • Process payments securely

    Protect and process sensitive payment data using a secure and trusted cloud service managed by SAP in a robust and scalable cloud environment.

Features

View media gallery

Analyze payment processing and status data in real time

Gain full control of payment authorization and processing in a single SAP S/4HANA Fiori application, allowing you to monitor, analyze, and manage the payment processing and status for all digital payment transactions integrated with SAP S/4HANA.

Support multiple payment methods

Provide a great customer experience with convenient payment pages or pay-per-link functionality with access to a wide range of payment options, including credit and debit cards, digital wallets or regional payment methods.

Integrate with SAP S/4HANA easily

Out-of-the-box SAP S/4HANA Cloud or on-premises integration provides payment management directly in financial accounting, allowing you to choose the payment service provider or method without the need for a custom interface.
